name: Tomb Raider: Side-Scroller Edition
summary:
This project reimagines the classic Tomb Raider games through a 2D side-scrolling lens.

Re-experience familiar locations, redesigned with new platforming challenges and traps unique to the side-scrolling perspective!

It features 10 stages, taking Lara Croft across iconic locations such as India, Greece, and Venice!

Hidden throughout the game are 100 optional Golden Crystals for players seeking full completion. A hidden bonus stage is unlocked after completing the game with all 100 Crystals collected!
